rows.source_ko: Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs ( Rural Income Policy Division ), 044-201-2817, 2818, 2819
rows.text_en: Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs (Rural Income Policy Division), 044-201-2817, 2818, 2819

rows.source_ko: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the “ Implementation Regulations on the Direct Payment System for Producers of Agricultural Products” pursuant to Article 11, Paragraph 2 of the “ Special Act on the Implementation of the World Trade Organization Agreement” and matters necessary for its implementation.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Enforcement Regulations on the Direct Payment System for Producers of Agricultural Products under Article 11 (2) of the Special Act on the Implementation of the World Trade Organization Agreement and matters necessary for their implementation.

rows.source_ko: Article 1-2 Deleted <April 15, 2024>
rows.text_en: Article 1-2 Deleted <April 15, 2024>

rows.source_ko: Article 2 (Establishment and Approval of Implementation Plan for the Farmland Transfer Retirement Direct Payment Project) ①When the Korea Rural Community Corporation established pursuant to the "Korea Rural Community Corporation and Farmland Management Fund Act" (hereinafter referred to as the “Corporation”) performs duties regarding the payment of farmland transfer retirement subsidies pursuant to Article 4, Paragraph 2 of the "Enforcement Regulations on the Direct Payment System for Producers of Agricultural Products" (hereinafter referred to as the “Enforcement Decree”),it shall establish an implementation plan for the farmland transfer retirement direct payment project (hereinafter referred to as the “Implementation Plan”) containing the matters of each of the following subparagraphs and obtain approval from the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs. <Amended June 22, 2012; March 23, 2013; April 15, 2024>
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Establishment and Approval of Implementation Plans for Farmland Transfer Retirement Direct Payments) ① When the Korea Rural Community Corporation established under the Korea Rural Community Corporation and Farmland Management Fund Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Corporation”) performs duties concerning farmland transfer retirement subsidies under Article 4 (2) of the Enforcement Decree on the Direct Payment System for Producers of Agricultural Products (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”), it shall prepare an implementation plan (hereinafter referred to as an “implementation plan”) containing the following matters and obtain approval from the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs. <Amended on June 22, 2012; March 23, 2013; April 15, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 1. Business Objectives
rows.text_en: 1. Project objectives

rows.source_ko: 2. Detailed Project Implementation Plan
rows.text_en: 2. Detailed project implementation plan

rows.source_ko: 3. Number of recipients of the farmland transfer retirement subsidy by city, county, or autonomous district and the necessary budget
rows.text_en: 3. Numbers of farmland transfer retirement subsidy recipients by city, county or autonomous district and the required budget

rows.source_ko: 4. Plan for Survey, Education, and Promotion for Smooth Project Implementation
rows.text_en: 4. Survey, education and publicity plan to facilitate implementation

rows.source_ko: ② Upon receiving approval for the implementation plan, the Corporation shall publicize an outline of the implementation plan, including the matters in each of the following subparagraphs, so that farmers may be aware of it. <Amended Apr. 15, 2024>
rows.text_en: ② After obtaining approval for an implementation plan, the Corporation shall publicize an outline of the plan, including the following matters, so that farmers can become aware of it. <Amended on April 15, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 1. Amount of the farmland transfer retirement subsidy for the relevant year
rows.text_en: 1. Amount of farmland transfer retirement subsidies for the relevant year

rows.source_ko: 2. Eligibility for Farmland Transfer Retirement Subsidy and Requirements for Eligible Farmland
rows.text_en: 2. Eligibility of applicants and farmland for farmland transfer retirement subsidies

rows.source_ko: 3. Application Method and Required Documents for Selection of Recipients for Farmland Transfer Retirement Subsidy
rows.text_en: 3. Application procedures and supporting documents for selecting subsidy recipients

rows.source_ko: 4. Method and Timing of Payment of Farmland Transfer Retirement Subsidy
rows.text_en: 4. Method and timing of subsidy payments

rows.source_ko: 5. Other matters necessary for the payment of farmland transfer retirement subsidies
rows.text_en: 5. Other matters necessary for paying farmland transfer retirement subsidies

rows.source_ko: [Title amended Apr. 15, 2024]
rows.text_en: [Title amended Apr. 15, 2024]

rows.source_ko: Article 3 (Age for Application of Farmland Transfer Retirement Subsidy) In Article 5, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree, the term “age prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs” refers to a person aged 65 or older and 84 or younger. <Amended Mar. 23, 2013; Apr. 7, 2015; Apr. 15, 2024>
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Age of Applicants for Farmland Transfer Retirement Subsidies) The age prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs under subparagraph 1 of Article 5 (1) of the Decree means persons at least 65 but no older than 84 years of age. <Amended on March 23, 2013; April 7, 2015; April 15, 2024>

rows.source_ko: [Title amended Apr. 15, 2024]
rows.text_en: [Title amended Apr. 15, 2024]

rows.source_ko: Article 3-2 (Restrictions on Application for Farmland Transfer Retirement Subsidy) In Article 5, Paragraph 2, Subparagraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree, the term “period prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs” refers to the period according to the classifications in each of the following subparagraphs.
rows.text_en: Article 3-2 (Restrictions on Applications for Farmland Transfer Retirement Subsidies) The period prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs under subparagraph 1 of Article 5 (2) of the Decree is as follows:

rows.source_ko: 1. In the event that the agreement is terminated due to a reason pursuant to Article 13, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree: 5 years
rows.text_en: 1. Where an agreement is terminated for a ground under subparagraph 1 of Article 13 (1) of the Decree: 5 years

rows.source_ko: 2. In the case where the agreement is terminated due to reasons pursuant to Article 13, Paragraph 1 , Subparagraphs 2 and 3 (only applicable if the agreement is terminated due to causes attributable to the counterparty) and Subparagraph 6 of the Enforcement Decree: 3 years
rows.text_en: 2. Where an agreement is terminated for a ground under subparagraph 2 or 3 of Article 13 (1) of the Decree (limited to termination attributable to the counterparty) or subparagraph 6 thereof: 3 years

rows.source_ko:
[This Article newly established on Apr. 7, 2015]
[Title amended on Apr. 15, 2024]
rows.text_en:
[This Article newly established on Apr. 7, 2015]
[Title amended on Apr. 15, 2024]

rows.source_ko: Article 4 (Farmland, etc. Eligible for Retirement Subsidy for Farmland Transfer) ① In Article 6, subparagraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree , the term “period prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs” refers to three years. <Amended Mar. 23, 2013>
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Farmland Eligible for Farmland Transfer Retirement Subsidies, etc.) ① The period prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs under subparagraph 1 of Article 6 of the Decree is 3 years. <Amended on March 23, 2013>

rows.source_ko: ② In Article 6 , subparagraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree, the term “paddy fields, dry fields, and orchards prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs” refers to paddy fields, dry fields, or orchards falling under any of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Dec. 15, 2009; Jun. 22, 2012; Mar. 23, 2013; Apr. 15, 2024>
rows.text_en: ② Paddy fields, dry fields or orchards prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs under subparagraph 2 of Article 6 of the Decree means those falling under any of the following: <Amended on December 15, 2009; June 22, 2012; March 23, 2013; April 15, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 1. 농지이양 이전에 「농어촌정비법」 제14조에 따라 농업생산기반 정비사업 시행자가 처분한 간척농지를 매입(분할납부로 소유권이 이전되기 전인 경우를 포함한다)하여 3년 이상 계속하여 경작한 논ㆍ밭ㆍ과수원
rows.text_en: 1. Paddy fields, dry fields or orchards continuously cultivated for at least 3 years after purchasing reclaimed farmland disposed of by an agricultural production infrastructure improvement project operator under Article 14 of the Rearrangement of Agricultural and Fishing Villages Act before the farmland transfer (including cases where ownership has not yet passed because the purchase price is paid in installments)

rows.source_ko: 2. 농지이양 이전에 3년 이상 계속하여 소유하고 있는 다음 각 목의 어느 하나에 해당하는 논ㆍ밭ㆍ과수원
rows.text_en: 2. Paddy fields, dry fields or orchards owned continuously for at least 3 years before transfer and falling under any of the following:

rows.source_ko: 가. 「농어촌정비법」에 따른 경지 정리사업을 마친 논ㆍ밭ㆍ과수원
rows.text_en: A. Farmland for which land consolidation projects under the Rearrangement of Agricultural and Fishing Villages Act have been completed

rows.source_ko: 나. 농지가 3만제곱미터 이상 집단화 되어 있는 지역의 농업생산기반시설이 완비된 농지로서 공사가 5년 이상 농업경영이 가능하다고 인정하는 논ㆍ밭ㆍ과수원
rows.text_en: B. Paddy fields, dry fields or orchards in areas of consolidated farmland of at least 30,000 square meters, equipped with agricultural production infrastructure, that the Corporation finds capable of agricultural operations for at least 5 years

rows.source_ko: ③ 제1항 및 제2항제2호에도 불구하고 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 논ㆍ밭ㆍ과수원에 대하여 3년 이상 계속하여 소유하였는지를 판단할 때에는 해당 호에서 규정한 기간을 합산한 기간을 기준으로 한다. <개정 2015. 4. 7.>
rows.text_en: ③ Notwithstanding paragraph (1) and paragraph (2) 2, when determining whether any of the following farmland has been owned continuously for at least 3 years, the periods specified below shall be included. <Amended on April 7, 2015>

rows.source_ko: 1. 상속받은 논ㆍ밭ㆍ과수원: 피상속인의 소유기간
rows.text_en: 1. Inherited farmland: The period during which the decedent owned it

rows.source_ko: 2. 배우자나 직계존속으로부터 증여받은 논ㆍ밭ㆍ과수원: 증여자의 소유기간
rows.text_en: 2. Farmland donated by a spouse or lineal ascendant: The donor's period of ownership

rows.source_ko: 3. 「한국농어촌공사 및 농지관리기금법」 제24조의3제3항에 따라 환매받은 논ㆍ밭ㆍ과수원: 해당 농업인이 같은 조 제1항에 따라 공사로부터 임차하기 전 소유한 기간
rows.text_en: 3. Farmland repurchased under Article 24-3 (3) of the Korea Rural Community Corporation and Farmland Management Fund Act: The farmer's period of ownership before leasing it from the Corporation under paragraph (1) of that Article
[Title amended Apr. 15, 2024]

rows.source_ko: 제5조(농지이양 후의 경작허용 규모 등) ① 영 제7조제1호가목에서 “농림축산식품부령으로 정하는 면적”이란 다음 각 호의 구분에 따른 면적을 말한다. <개정 2024. 4. 15.>
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Permitted Scale of Cultivation following Farmland Transfer, etc.) ① The area prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs under item (a) of subparagraph 1 of Article 7 of the Decree shall be as follows: <Amended on April 15, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 1. 영 제6조에 따른 농지이양은퇴보조금 지급대상 농지만 소유하고 있는 경우: 1천제곱미터 미만
rows.text_en: 1. Where only farmland eligible for farmland transfer retirement subsidies under Article 6 of the Decree is owned: Less than 1,000 square meters

rows.source_ko: 2. 영 제6조에 따른 농지이양은퇴보조금 지급대상 농지와 다른 농지를 함께 소유하고 있는 경우: 3천제곱미터 이하. 이 경우 영 제6조에 따른 농지이양은퇴보조금 지급대상 농지는 1천제곱미터 미만이어야 한다.
rows.text_en: 2. Where other farmland is also owned together with eligible farmland: No more than 3,000 square meters in total, provided that the eligible farmland occupies less than 1,000 square meters

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제7조제1호나목에서 “농림축산식품부령으로 정하는 사유”란 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 경우를 말한다. <개정 2013. 3. 23., 2024. 4. 15.>
rows.text_en: ② The grounds prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs under item (b) of subparagraph 1 of Article 7 of the Decree mean any of the following cases: <Amended on March 23, 2013; April 15, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 1. 「관광진흥법」 제52조에 따라 관광지 및 관광단지로 지정된 경우
rows.text_en: 1. Cases designated as a tourist site or tourist complex pursuant to Article 52 of the Tourism Promotion Act

rows.source_ko: 2. 「국토의 계획 및 이용에 관한 법률」 제36조제1항제1호에 따라 주거지역ㆍ상업지역 또는 공업지역으로 지정된 경우
rows.text_en: 2. Cases where it has been designated as a residential, commercial, or industrial area pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 1 of the National Land Planning and Utilization Act

rows.source_ko: 3. 「국토의 계획 및 이용에 관한 법률」 제37조제1항제5호에 따라 보호지구로 지정된 경우
rows.text_en: 3. Cases where it has been designated as a protected district pursuant to Article 37, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 5 of the Act on Planning and Utilization of National Land

rows.source_ko: 4. 「농지법」 제34조에 따른 농지의 전용허가ㆍ협의(다른 법률에 따라 의제되는 경우를 포함한다)를 받거나 같은 법 제35조 또는 제43조에 따른 농지전용신고(다른 법률에 따라 의제되는 경우를 포함한다)를 한 경우
rows.text_en: 4. Cases where permission or consultation for the conversion of farmland has been obtained pursuant to Article 34 of the Farmland Act (including cases deemed as such under other laws), or where a report on the conversion of farmland has been filed pursuant to Article 35 or Article 43 of the same Act (including cases deemed as such under other laws).

rows.source_ko: 5. 「도로법」 제25조에 따라 도로구역으로 결정된 경우
rows.text_en: 5. Cases where it has been determined as a road area pursuant to Article 25 of the Road Act

rows.source_ko: 6. 「도시개발법」 제3조에 따라 도시개발구역으로 지정된 경우
rows.text_en: 6. Cases where an area has been designated as an urban development zone pursuant to Article 3 of the Urban Development Act

rows.source_ko: 7. 「산업입지 및 개발에 관한 법률」 제6조ㆍ제7조ㆍ제7조의2 또는 제8조에 따라 국가산업단지ㆍ일반산업단지ㆍ도시첨단산업단지 또는 농공단지로 지정된 경우
rows.text_en: 7. Cases where it has been designated as a national industrial complex, general industrial complex, urban high-tech industrial complex, or agricultural-industrial complex pursuant to Article 6 , Article 7 , Article 7-2 , or Article 8 of the Industrial Location and Development Act

rows.source_ko: 8. 「산업집적활성화 및 공장설립에 관한 법률」 제23조에 따라 유치지역으로 지정된 경우
rows.text_en: 8. Cases where an area has been designated as a host region pursuant to Article 23 of the Act on the Promotion of Industrial Cluster Development and Factory Establishment

rows.source_ko: 9. 「자유무역지역의 지정 및 운영에 관한 법률」 제4조에 따라 자유무역지역으로 지정된 경우
rows.text_en: 9. Cases where it has been designated as a free trade zone pursuant to Article 4 of the Act on the Designation and Operation of Free Trade Zones

rows.source_ko: 10. 「전원개발촉진법」 제5조에 따른 전원개발사업실시계획에 전원개발사업구역으로 포함되거나 같은 법 제11조에 따라 전원개발사업예정구역으로 지정된 경우
rows.text_en: 10. Land included in an electric power development project area in an implementation plan under Article 5 of the Electric Power Source Development Promotion Act or designated as a planned development area under Article 11 of that Act

rows.source_ko: 11. 「철도건설법」 제9조에 따른 철도건설사업실시계획의 사업구역으로 승인을 받은 경우
rows.text_en: 11. Land included in an approved railway construction project implementation area under Article 9 of the Railway Construction Act

rows.source_ko: 12. 「택지개발촉진법」 제3조에 따라 택지개발지구로 지정된 경우
rows.text_en: 12. Land designated as a housing site development district under Article 3 of the Housing Site Development Promotion Act
[Title amended Apr. 15, 2024]

rows.source_ko: 제6조(농지이양은퇴보조금의 지급기간) 영 제8조제2항에서 “농림축산식품부령으로 정하는 연령별 지급기간”이란 별표 1과 같다. <개정 2012. 6. 22., 2013. 3. 23.>
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Period for Payment of Farmland Transfer Retirement Subsidies) The period by age prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs under Article 8 (2) of the Decree shall be as specified in attached Table 1. <Amended on June 22, 2012; March 23, 2013>
[Title amended Apr. 15, 2024]

rows.source_ko: 제6조의2(농지이양 면적의 상한) 영 제8조제4항에 따른 농지이양 면적의 상한은 매도한 농지와 임대 또는 임대위탁한 농지를 합하여 4만제곱미터로 한다. <개정 2024. 4. 15.>
rows.text_en: Article 6-2 (Maximum Area for Farmland Transfer) The maximum area under Article 8 (4) of the Decree shall be 40,000 square meters in total for farmland sold, leased, or entrusted for lease. <Amended on April 15, 2024>

[This Article newly established on Apr. 7, 2015]
[Title amended on Apr. 15, 2024]

rows.source_ko: 제7조(농지이양은퇴보조금 지급대상자 선정 신청) ① 영 제9조에 따라 농지이양은퇴보조금을 받으려는 농업인은 별지 제1호서식에 따른 농지이양은퇴보조금 지급대상자 선정신청서(이하 “농지이양은퇴보조금신청서”라 한다)에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 공사에 제출하여야 한다. <개정 2015. 4. 7., 2022. 5. 18., 2024. 4. 15.>
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Applications for Selection as Farmland Transfer Retirement Subsidy Recipients) ① A farmer seeking a subsidy under Article 9 of the Decree shall submit an application using attached Form No. 1 (hereinafter referred to as a “subsidy application”), with the following documents, to the Corporation. <Amended on April 7, 2015; May 18, 2022; April 15, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 1. 농지대장 등본
rows.text_en: 1. Certified copy of the farmland register

rows.source_ko: 2. 매매계약서 사본(영 제2조제3호에 따른 전업농업인등에게 직접 매도하는 경우에만 해당한다)
rows.text_en: 2. Copy of the sales agreement (only where the farmland is sold directly to a full-time farmer or other person under subparagraph 3 of Article 2 of the Decree)

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따라 농지이양은퇴보조금신청서를 받은 공사의 담당직원은 「전자정부법」 제36조제1항에 따른 행정정보의 공동이용 또는 「농어업경영체 육성 및 지원에 관한 법률 시행규칙」 제5조에 따른 농업경영정보시스템을 통하여 다음 각 호의 사항을 확인하여야 한다. 다만, 신청인이 제1호 및 제3호의 사항을 확인하는 데에 동의하지 아니하는 경우에는 해당 서류를 첨부하도록 하여야 한다. <개정 2015. 4. 7., 2018. 3. 20., 2024. 4. 15.>
rows.text_en: ② The responsible employee of the Corporation receiving an application under paragraph (1) shall verify the following through shared administrative information under Article 36 (1) of the Electronic Government Act or the agricultural management information system under Article 5 of the Enforcement Rule of the Act on Fostering and Supporting Agricultural and Fisheries Business Entities. If the applicant does not consent to verification of the matters under subparagraphs 1 and 3, the applicant shall be required to attach the relevant documents. <Amended on April 7, 2015; March 20, 2018; April 15, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 1. 주민등록표 초본, 가족관계증명서 및 출입국에 관한 사실증명서. 다만, 외국인의 경우에는 외국인등록사실증명서, 국내거소신고사실증명서 및 출입국에 관한 사실증명서를 말한다.
rows.text_en: 1. Abstract of resident registration, certificate of family relations, and entry and exit records; for a foreign national, certificate of alien registration, certificate of domestic residence report, and entry and exit records

rows.source_ko: 2. 토지대장(임야대장), 토지등기사항증명서 및 개별공시지가 확인서
rows.text_en: 2. Land register (or forest land register), certificate of registered land particulars, and individual officially assessed land price certificate

rows.source_ko: 3. 「농어업경영체 육성 및 지원에 관한 법률 시행규칙」 제3조제5항에 따른 농업경영체 증명서
rows.text_en: 3. Certificate of registration of an agricultural business entity under Article 3 (5) of the Enforcement Rule of the Act on Fostering and Supporting Agricultural and Fisheries Business Entities
[Title amended Apr. 15, 2024]

rows.source_ko: 제8조(농지이양은퇴보조금 지급대상자 선정) ① 공사는 제7조에 따른 농지이양은퇴보조금신청서를 제출받은 날부터 60일 이내에 농지이양은퇴보조금 지급대상자를 선정하여야 한다. <개정 2024. 4. 15.>
rows.text_en: Article 8 (Selection of Farmland Transfer Retirement Subsidy Recipients) ① The Corporation shall select subsidy recipients within 60 days after receiving an application under Article 7. <Amended on April 15, 2024>

rows.source_ko: ② 공사는 영 제11조에 따라 농지이양은퇴보조금 지급대상자 선정 결과를 별지 제2호서식으로 신청인에게 알려야 한다. <개정 2024. 4. 15.>
rows.text_en: ② The Corporation shall notify the applicant of the selection outcome under Article 11 of the Decree using attached Form No. 2. <Amended on April 15, 2024>
[Title amended Apr. 15, 2024]

rows.source_ko: 제9조(농지이양은퇴보조금의 지급 등) 영 제12조제1항 후단에 따라 농지이양은퇴보조금을 분할하여 지급하는 경우에는 영 제8조제2항에 따른 농지이양은퇴보조금 지급액을 연령별 지급기간의 총 월수로 나누어 매월 지급하는 방법에 따른다. <개정 2024. 4. 15.>
rows.text_en: Article 9 (Payment of Farmland Transfer Retirement Subsidies, etc.) Where the subsidy is paid in installments under the latter part of Article 12 (1) of the Decree, the amount payable each month shall be the total subsidy calculated under Article 8 (2) of the Decree divided by the total number of months in the age-based payment period. <Amended on April 15, 2024>
[Title amended Apr. 15, 2024]

Article 12-3 Deleted <April 15, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 제12조의5(조건불리보조금 신청을 위한 최소 토지면적) 영 제26조제2항제2호에서 “농림축산식품부령으로 정하는 면적”이란 농지(휴경 중인 농지는 제외한다)와 초지로 구분하여 각각 1천제곱미터를 말한다. <개정 2018. 3. 20.>
rows.text_en: Article 12-5 (Minimum Land Area for Applications for Less-Favored Area Subsidies) The area prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs under subparagraph 2 of Article 26 (2) of the Decree means 1,000 square meters each for farmland (excluding fallow farmland) and grassland, considered separately. <Amended on March 20, 2018>

[This Article newly inserted on Apr. 7, 2015]
[Moved from Article 12-2 on Aug. 3, 2015>]

rows.source_ko: 제13조(조건불리보조금의 지급대상 제외 토지) 영 제27조제1호다목에 따라 조건불리지역소득보조금(이하 “조건불리보조금”이라 한다) 지급대상에서 제외하는 토지는 다음 각 호와 같다. <개정 2018. 3. 20., 2024. 4. 15.>
rows.text_en: Article 13 (Land Excluded from Less-Favored Area Subsidies) Land excluded from eligibility for less-favored area income subsidies (hereinafter referred to as “less-favored area subsidies”) under item (c) of subparagraph 1 of Article 27 of the Decree is as follows: <Amended on March 20, 2018; April 15, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 1. 다음 각 목의 어느 하나에 해당하는 토지. 다만, 영 제29조제1항에 따라 조건불리보조금 지급을 신청한 연도의 직전 연도까지 각 목의 법령에 따른 보상을 받지 아니한 토지분에 대하여 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수 또는 자치구의 구청장이 1년 이상 농업에 이용할 수 있는 농지로 인정하거나 초지로 관리될 수 있는 초지로 인정하는 경우에는 그러하지 아니하다.
rows.text_en: 1. Land falling under any of the following items. However, the exclusion shall not apply to land for which no compensation under the relevant statute has been received through the year preceding the application under Article 29 (1) of the Decree, where the competent special self-governing city mayor, special self-governing provincial governor, mayor, county head, or autonomous district head recognizes the land as usable for agriculture for at least 1 year or as grassland that can be maintained as such.

rows.source_ko: 가. 「국토의 계획 및 이용에 관한 법률」 제36조제1항제1호에 따라 지정된 주거지역ㆍ상업지역 및 공업지역의 토지
rows.text_en: A. Land in residential, commercial or industrial zones designated under subparagraph 1 of Article 36 (1) of the National Land Planning and Utilization Act

rows.source_ko: 나. 「산업입지 및 개발에 관한 법률」 제6조ㆍ제7조ㆍ제7조의2 또는 제8조에 따라 지정된 국가산업단지ㆍ일반산업단지ㆍ도시첨단산업단지 또는 농공단지의 토지
rows.text_en: B. Land in national, general, urban high-tech or agricultural-industrial complexes designated under Articles 6, 7, 7-2 or 8 of the Industrial Sites and Development Act

rows.source_ko: 다. 「택지개발촉진법」 제3조에 따라 지정된 택지개발예정지구의 토지
rows.text_en: C. Land in planned housing site development districts designated under Article 3 of the Housing Site Development Promotion Act

rows.source_ko: 라. 「하천법」 제2조제2호에 따른 하천구역의 토지
rows.text_en: D. Land within a river area under subparagraph 2 of Article 2 of the River Act

rows.source_ko: 마. 그 밖에 다른 법률에 따라 각종 개발사업 예정지로 지정되거나 고시된 지역의 토지
rows.text_en: E. Land in an area designated or publicly notified as a planned development project site under another statute

rows.source_ko: 2. 「농업소득의 보전에 관한 법률」 제10조제1항에 따른 고정직접지불금 지급대상 토지
rows.text_en: 2. Land eligible for fixed direct payments under Article 10 (1) of the Act on the Preservation of Agricultural Income

rows.source_ko: 3. 「공간정보의 구축 및 관리 등에 관한 법률」상 지목이 임야인 토지로서 그 형질을 변경하지 아니하고 농작물을 재배하는 토지
rows.text_en: 3. Land registered as forest land under the Act on the Establishment and Management of Spatial Data, etc., where crops are cultivated without changing its physical form

rows.source_ko: 4. 「초지법」 제23조에 따른 초지의 전용허가를 받거나 전용신고를 하지 아니하고 농작물재배용지로 이용되는 초지
rows.text_en: 4. Grassland used for crop cultivation without permission for, or notification of, conversion under Article 23 of the Grassland Act

rows.source_ko: 5. 「초지법」 제24조에 따른 초지관리 실태조사 결과 하급 등급을 받은 초지
rows.text_en: 5. Grassland assigned a low grade based on a management status survey under Article 24 of the Grassland Act

rows.source_ko: 6. 그 밖에 농림축산식품부장관이 조건불리보조금을 지급하는 것이 적절하지 아니하다고 정하는 토지
rows.text_en: 6. Other land for which the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs considers payment of less-favored area subsidies inappropriate
[Wholly Amended Apr. 7, 2015]

rows.source_ko: 제14조(조건불리지역 운영위원회 구성 및 운영) ① 영 제28조제2항에 따른 조건불리지역 운영위원회(이하 이 조에서 “운영위원회”라 한다)는 영 제26조에 따른 조건불리보조금의 신청 대상자 중에서 위원장 1명을 포함한 3명 이상 5명 이하의 운영위원으로 구성한다.
rows.text_en: Article 14 (Composition and Operation of the Less-Favored Area Steering Committee) ① The Steering Committee under Article 28 (2) of the Decree shall comprise 3 to 5 members, including 1 chairperson, selected from eligible subsidy applicants under Article 26 of the Decree.

rows.source_ko: ② 운영위원회의 위원장은 운영위원회를 대표하고, 운영위원회의 업무를 총괄한다.
rows.text_en: ② The Chairperson of the Steering Committee represents the Steering Committee and oversees the affairs of the Steering Committee.

rows.source_ko: ③ 제1항과 제2항에서 규정한 사항 외에 운영위원회의 운영에 필요한 사항은 운영위원회의 협의를 거쳐 운영위원회의 위원장이 정한다.
rows.text_en: ③ In addition to the matters prescribed in Paragraphs 1 and 2, matters necessary for the operation of the Steering Committee shall be determined by the Chairperson of the Steering Committee after consultation with the Steering Committee.

rows.source_ko: 제14조의2(조건불리보조금 지급 약정신청서 제출) 영 제29조제1항에 따라 조건불리보조금을 지급받으려는 자는 농림축산식품부장관이 정하는 조건불리보조금 지급 약정신청서(이하 “약정신청서”라 한다)를 조건불리보조금 지급대상 토지 소재지(해당 토지가 둘 이상의 읍ㆍ면ㆍ동에 있는 경우에는 면적이 가장 넓은 토지의 소재지를 말한다)를 관할하는 읍장ㆍ면장ㆍ동장(이하 “읍ㆍ면ㆍ동장”이라 한다)에게 제출하여야 한다. 다만, 「농어업경영체 육성 및 지원에 관한 법률 시행규칙」 제3조제1항제2호 또는 제4조제2항제1호에 따라 농업경영체 등록 신청서 또는 농업경영체 변경등록 신청서를 읍ㆍ면ㆍ동장 또는 국립농산물품질관리원장에게 제출한 경우에는 약정신청서를 제출한 것으로 본다. <개정 2018. 3. 20.>
rows.text_en: Article 14-2 (Submission of Applications for Payment Agreements for Less-Favored Area Subsidies) A person seeking a subsidy under Article 29 (1) of the Decree shall submit an application for a payment agreement in the form prescribed by the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs (hereinafter referred to as an “agreement application”) to the head of the eup, myeon or dong having jurisdiction over the eligible land (where the land spans 2 or more such areas, the location containing the largest area of land). However, where the person submits an application for registration or amended registration of an agricultural business entity under subparagraph 2 of Article 3 (1) or subparagraph 1 of Article 4 (2) of the Enforcement Rule of the Act on Fostering and Supporting Agricultural and Fisheries Business Entities to the relevant head of an eup, myeon or dong or to the Director of the National Agricultural Products Quality Management Service, the agreement application shall be deemed submitted. <Amended on March 20, 2018>
[This Article Newly Inserted April 7, 2015]

rows.source_ko: 제15조(관리협약의 체결 등) 영 제31조제2항제6호에 따라 관리협약에 포함되어야 할 사항은 다음 각 호와 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 15 (Conclusion of Management Agreements, etc.) A management agreement under subparagraph 6 of Article 31 (2) of the Decree shall contain the following matters:

rows.source_ko: 1. 조건불리보조금의 지급제한에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 1. Restrictions on payment of less-favored area subsidies

rows.source_ko: 2. 조건불리보조금의 신청 대상자의 자격상실에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 2. Loss of eligibility of applicants for less-favored area subsidies

rows.source_ko: 제15조의2(조건불리보조금 지급대상 토지면적의 상한) 영 제32조제5항에 따른 조건불리보조금 지급대상 토지면적의 상한은 다음 각 호와 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 15-2 (Maximum Area of Land Eligible for Less-Favored Area Subsidies) The maximum land area eligible for less-favored area subsidies under Article 32 (5) of the Decree shall be as follows:

rows.source_ko: 1. 농업인의 경우
rows.text_en: 1. For individual farmers:

rows.source_ko: 가. 밭ㆍ과수원: 해당 농지를 합하여 4만제곱미터
rows.text_en: A. Dry fields and orchards: A combined total of 40,000 square meters

rows.source_ko: 나. 논: 30만제곱미터
rows.text_en: B. Paddy fields: 300,000 square meters

rows.source_ko: 다. 초지: 30만제곱미터
rows.text_en: C. Grassland: 300,000 square meters

rows.source_ko: 2. 「농어업경영체 육성 및 지원에 관한 법률」 제16조에 따른 영농조합법인(이하 “영농조합법인”이라 한다) 또는 같은 법 제19조에 따른 농업회사법인(이하 “농업회사법인”이라 한다)의 경우
rows.text_en: 2. For an agricultural partnership corporation under Article 16 of the Act on Fostering and Supporting Agricultural and Fisheries Business Entities (hereinafter referred to as an “agricultural partnership corporation”) or an agricultural company corporation under Article 19 thereof (hereinafter referred to as an “agricultural company corporation”):

rows.source_ko: 가. 밭ㆍ과수원: 해당 농지를 합하여 10만제곱미터
rows.text_en: A. Dry fields and orchards: A combined total of 100,000 square meters

rows.source_ko: 나. 논: 50만제곱미터
rows.text_en: B. Paddy fields: 500,000 square meters

rows.source_ko: 다. 초지: 50만제곱미터
rows.text_en: C. Grassland: 500,000 square meters
[Article Newly Inserted on April 7, 2015]

rows.source_ko: 제27조(직접지불제도 관련 정보의 공개) ① 영 제44조제1항에 따른 정보 공개는 농림축산식품부, 국립농산물품질관리원, 특별자치시ㆍ시(「제주특별자치도 설치 및 국제자유도시 조성을 위한 특별법」에 따른 행정시를 포함한다)ㆍ군ㆍ구(자치구를 말한다) 및 공사의 인터넷 홈페이지에 다음 각 호에서 정한 날을 기준으로 30일 이내에 15일 이상의 기간 동안 열람하게 하는 방법으로 하여야 한다. <개정 2013. 3. 23., 2014. 3. 18., 2015. 4. 7., 2016. 5. 4., 2024. 4. 15.>
rows.text_en: Article 27 (Disclosure of Information relating to the Direct Payment System) ① Information under Article 44 (1) of the Decree shall be disclosed by making it available for public inspection for at least 15 days within 30 days after the relevant reference date specified below on the websites of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs, the National Agricultural Products Quality Management Service, the relevant special self-governing city, city (including an administrative city under the Special Act on the Establishment of Jeju Special Self-Governing Province and the Development of Free International City), county or autonomous district, and the Corporation. <Amended on March 23, 2013; March 18, 2014; April 7, 2015; May 4, 2016; April 15, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 1. 보조금의 신청정보
rows.text_en: 1. Information concerning subsidy applications

rows.source_ko: 가. 농지이양은퇴보조금: 매월 말일
rows.text_en: A. Farmland transfer retirement subsidy: The last day of each month
B. Deleted <April 15, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 다. 조건불리보조금: 영 제29조제1항에 따른 약정신청서 제출을 마감한 날
rows.text_en: C. Less-favored area subsidy: The deadline for submission of agreement applications under Article 29 (1) of the Decree
D. Deleted <April 15, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 2. 보조금의 수령정보

rows.source_ko: 가. 농지이양은퇴보조금: 영 제12조제1항에 따라 농지이양은퇴보조금을 지급한 날
rows.text_en: A. Farmland transfer retirement subsidy: The date of payment under Article 12 (1) of the Decree
B. Deleted <April 15, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 다. 조건불리보조금: 영 제32조제1항에 따라 조건불리보조금을 지급한 날
rows.text_en: C. Less-favored area subsidy: The date of payment under Article 32 (1) of the Decree
D. Deleted <April 15, 2024>

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따라 보조금의 신청정보 및 수령정보를 열람하려는 자는 열람 목적과 본인의 개인정보를 제공하여야 한다. <개정 2015. 4. 7.>
rows.text_en: ② A person seeking access to application and receipt information under paragraph (1) shall provide the purpose of access and their own personal information. <Amended on April 7, 2015>

rows.source_ko: ③ 제1항 및 제2항에 따른 정보 열람방법과 열람 신청자의 개인정보 제공방법에 관한 세부사항 등은 농림축산식품부장관이 정하여 고시한다. <개정 2013. 3. 23.>
rows.text_en: ③ Details concerning how the information may be inspected and how applicants for inspection must provide their personal information under paragraphs (1) and (2) shall be determined and publicly notified by the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs. <Amended on March 23, 2013>
[This Article Newly Inserted June 22, 2012]

rows.source_ko: 제28조(공개된 정보에 대한 이의신청 내용ㆍ방법 등) ① 제27조제1항제1호에 따른 보조금 신청정보에 대한 열람기간 중 열람한 내용에 대하여 이의가 있는 자는 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장(자치구의 구청장을 말한다. 이하 같다) 또는 공사에 서면으로 이의신청을 할 수 있다. <개정 2014. 3. 18., 2015. 4. 7.>
rows.text_en: Article 28 (Objections concerning Disclosed Information) ① A person objecting to information inspected during the inspection period for subsidy applications under subparagraph 1 of Article 27 (1) may file a written objection with the relevant special self-governing city mayor, special self-governing provincial governor, mayor, county head, autonomous district head, or Corporation. <Amended on March 18, 2014; April 7, 2015>

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 이의신청을 받은 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장 또는 공사는 현지조사를 실시한 후 그 결과를 이의신청자 및 보조금 신청자에게 알려야 한다. <개정 2014. 3. 18., 2015. 4. 7., 2016. 5. 4.>
rows.text_en: ② An authority or the Corporation receiving an objection under paragraph (1) shall conduct an on-site investigation and notify the objector and subsidy applicant of the outcome. <Amended on March 18, 2014; April 7, 2015; May 4, 2016>

rows.source_ko: 제2조(경영이양보조금의 신청 연령에 관한 적용례) 제3조의 개정규정은 이 규칙 시행 전에 신청하여 이 규칙 시행 당시 선정절차가 진행 중인 분에 대해서도 적용한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Applicability concerning Age Requirements for Applications for Farm Management Transfer Subsidies) The amendment to Article 3 shall also apply to applications filed before this Rule enters into force where the selection procedure remains pending on that date.

rows.source_ko: 제3조(경영이양보조금 지급대상 농지에 관한 적용례) 제4조제3항제3호의 개정규정은 이 규칙 시행 전에 신청하여 이 규칙 시행 당시 선정절차가 진행 중인 분에 대해서도 적용한다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Applicability concerning Farmland Eligible for Farm Management Transfer Subsidies) The amendment to subparagraph 3 of Article 4 (3) shall also apply to applications filed before this Rule enters into force where the selection procedure remains pending on that date.

rows.source_ko: 제4조(친환경농업보조금의 지급횟수 등에 관한 적용례) 제10조의 개정규정은 이 규칙 시행 전에 신청하여 이 규칙 시행 당시 선정절차가 진행 중인 분에 대해서도 적용한다.
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Applicability concerning the Number of Environment-Friendly Agriculture Subsidy Payments) The amendment to Article 10 shall also apply to applications filed before this Rule enters into force where the selection procedure remains pending on that date.

rows.source_ko: 제5조(마을경관보전추진위원회 구성에 관한 적용례) 제17조제1항의 개정규정은 이 규칙 시행 전에 신청하여 이 규칙 시행 당시 선정절차가 진행 중인 분에 대해서도 적용한다.
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Applicability concerning the Composition of Village Landscape Preservation Promotion Committees) The amendment to Article 17 (1) shall also apply to applications filed before this Rule enters into force where the selection procedure remains pending on that date.

rows.source_ko: 제6조(밭농업보조금의 지급대상 제외 농지에 관한 적용례) 제18조제2호나목의 개정규정은 이 규칙 시행 전에 신청하여 이 규칙 시행 당시 등록절차가 진행 중인 분에 대해서도 적용한다.
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Applicability concerning Farmland Excluded from Subsidies for Dry-Field Farming) The amendment to item (b) of subparagraph 2 of Article 18 shall also apply to applications filed before this Rule enters into force where the registration procedure remains pending on that date.

rows.source_ko: 제7조(농업을 주업으로 하는 자에 관한 적용례) 제19조제1호의 개정규정은 이 규칙 시행 전에 신청하여 이 규칙 시행 당시 등록절차가 진행 중인 분에 대해서도 적용한다.
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Applicability concerning Persons Whose Principal Occupation Is Farming) The amendment to subparagraph 1 of Article 19 shall also apply to applications filed before this Rule enters into force where the registration procedure remains pending on that date.

rows.source_ko: 제8조(밭농업보조금 지급대상 농지면적의 상한에 관한 적용례) 별표 2제1호가목의 개정규정은 이 규칙 시행 전에 신청하여 이 규칙 시행 당시 등록절차가 진행 중인 분에 대해서도 적용한다.
rows.text_en: Article 8 (Applicability concerning the Maximum Farmland Area Eligible for Dry-Field Farming Subsidies) The amendment to item (a) of subparagraph 1 of attached Table 2 shall also apply to applications filed before this Rule enters into force where the registration procedure remains pending on that date.
